scope: isolated direct-BBS loopback TLS HTTP/1.1 mixed load; edge separately covered by real TLS regressions
notes: Derived summaries and acceptance were recomputed using final code; raw events and timing were not changed.
The early/slow-429 counters in the first three normal20 raw reports were corrected to include only slow_body; originals are retained locally with .original.json suffix.
Original normal20 candidate r2 did not record rejection status/stage; its two normal failures have no confirmed cause.
Older raw slow events lack sent=true, but their ~5s/~10s remote disconnects and returned headers were captured after successful sendall.
memory_peak_bytes is cgroup memory.peak, not process RSS.
All mixed load runs are short synthetic runs, not production/WAN/botnet or sustained-capacity guarantees.
